basic_info.description: Near the border of Ingleside Terrace and Merced Heights, this beautiful and bright 3 bedroom + office, 2 bathroom single family home features a long list of recent improvements: new roof and skylights, new electrical service, new electrical panel, new switches/GFI plugs, new light fixtures, interior and exterior paint, refinished wood floors, refinished terrazzo steps, furnace refresh and duct cleaning. Attractive period details are present throughout this family property including original wood parquet floors, handsome fireplace mantle and hearth, built-in shelving, center patio, crown molding, and arched openings. Main level includes living room with fireplace, dining room with entry to covered center patio, kitchen with skylight, 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, and office nook.  Upper level features primary bedroom with ensuite bathroom, family room/2nd office with ocean and city views. Large garage with parking for multiple cars, plenty of storage and washer/dryer. Voluntary seismic upgrades to concrete foundation include plywood sheer walls and anchor bolts (2013). Generous yard with concrete patio. Owned by the same family for 50+ years. This home is located a short walk from Whole Foods and Philz Coffee (0.7mile), Java on Ocean, Charm Coffee and That's Amore Italian (0.5mi).
